crearCuenta.title: Create your player account
crearCuenta.subtitle: Answer the 7 questions to create your account.
crearCuenta.name_hint: Letters, spaces, hyphen or apostrophe only. 2 to 50 characters.
crearCuenta.name_bad: Use only letters, spaces, hyphen or apostrophe (2 to 50 characters).
crearCuenta.age_bad: Enter a whole number between 1 and 120.
crearCuenta.dob_bad: Use the DD/MM/YYYY format with a real date.
crearCuenta.hours_label: What's the minimum time you want to spend on the game?
crearCuenta.hours_hint: A number greater than 0. Decimals are allowed (1.5).
crearCuenta.id_label: What's the ID the program gave you?
crearCuenta.id_hint: 3 uppercase letters, a hyphen and 5 numbers.
crearCuenta.id_bad: The ID must follow the format XXX-00000 (3 letters, a hyphen and 5 numbers).
crearCuenta.contact_label: Where should we send your ID?
crearCuenta.contact_hint: Choose whether you prefer email or phone.
crearCuenta.phone_bad: Enter a valid phone number (9 to 15 digits).
crearCuenta.password_hint: At least 7 characters, no spaces and 2 uppercase letters.
crearCuenta.password_bad: Use at least 7 characters with no spaces and 2 uppercase letters.
crearCuenta.registro_id_existe: That ID is already registered. Review the data.
crearCuenta.registro_error: Could not create the account. Try again.
